page.overview:
Who is Apple Munchies?

Apple Munchies is a female Earth pony and member of the Apple family. She has a light green coat, gold mane and tail, reddish-orange eyes, and a cutie mark of three red apple cores. She is unnamed in the show, but she is named in merchandise and other media.

Apple Munchies shares her design and cutie mark with Apple Cider, and she shares her design with Peachy Sweet, S05E06 Unnamed Earth Mare #8, S05E06 Unnamed Earth Mare #16, and Canterlot Shopkeep.

Apple Munchies appears at Applejack's welcome home party in The Last Roundup.

She parties with the buffalo at the beginning of Pinkie Pride, and she spectates the Equestria Games in the episode of the same name.
